dcterms:description: MultiWOZ 3.0 is a reannotation of the MultiWOZ 2.1 dataset, which includes English task-oriented dialogues across five domains: Attraction, Hotel, Restaurant, Taxi, and Train. The dataset aims to improve the accuracy of semantic parsers by providing a more precise formal representation of dialogues.
dcterms:title: MultiWOZ 3.0

dcterms:description: A synthesized dataset generated using a state-machine-based simulator and agent, consisting of 1.5 million dialogues across all five domains.
dcterms:title: Synthesized Dataset

dcterms:description: A paraphrase dataset obtained by automatically paraphrasing the synthesized data to increase the variety of natural language in each turn.
dcterms:title: Paraphrase Dataset

dcterms:description: A few-shot dataset consisting of a split of 168 dialogues from the original validation set of MultiWOZ 2.1, representing 2% of the original training set.
dcterms:title: Few-Shot Dataset

dcterms:description: A self-trained dataset obtained by self-training on the MultiWOZ training set, leveraging unannotated data to improve model performance.
dcterms:title: Self-Trained Dataset
